name: greenforce-os
description: GreenForce OS — jurisdiction-aware construction compliance MVP

scripts.build: npm run build -w @greenforce/shared && npm run build -w @greenforce/backend && npm run build -w @greenforce/frontend
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n shared,backend,frontend -c gray,blue,green "npm run dev -w @greenforce/shared" "npm run dev -w @greenforce/backend" "npm run dev -w @greenforce/frontend"
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run format:check && npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.build:frontend: npm run build -w @greenforce/shared && npm run build -w @greenforce/frontend
